text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Peeking into the studio, I saw 
K.S.Miracle practicing her dance routine."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah—... Ah, Trainer. Hello.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you very much. I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I play the piano, so... Keeping rhythm is 
kind of my specialty."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like something's missing, 
or rather... I feel like I could do even 
more.
choice_data_list:
Even though you're dancing well enough 
already?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. —Because the concert is a place where 
I can tell all my fans "thank you" 
directly.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want to do my best to convey it 
properly, but…… right now, it feels like 
I'm still just following the textbook."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What should I do to make my dancing 
better...?"
choice_data_list: Let's try dancing with more freedom!

How about trying to enjoy your dancing 
more?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: More freely, you say? Freedom, huh—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And so, you chose me? Whether I can become 
a gust of wind for you, Miracle-san... 
only the wind knows, but.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. I like your dance, 
Zephyr. It's so free.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Freedom... That is true. I always wish to 
be like a wind rustling the leaves, bound 
by nothing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Well then— let us begin 
with becoming a gentle breeze."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Let the gentle breeze turn into a swift 
wind. Let the crosswind become a favorable 
wind. Feel the wind, and become the wind."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It looks a bit tough, but I'll do 
my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having learned what it means to be 
free, KS Miracle delivered a stunning 
dance performance during the live concert.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Even more fun, you say? Let's see—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pop-pop-pop-po~w☆ YO! YO! Heli-chin, In Da 
HOUSE whooo~!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And the secret to dancing with a smile, 
you ask? It's all about catching the vibe!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First is the groove, second is the vibes! 
Who cares about three and four, aren't 
they totally whatever anyway?! Wheeey☆

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, rhythm and vibes... I wonder how I 
can bring those out?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, Miracle, you gotta be a party 
animal too! Come on! Follow me, your 
Teacher-Sensei~~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah. I'll do my best to become a 
party animal...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having picked up a fun groove, KS 
Miracle delivered a spectacular dance 
performance during the concert.
